title: 安全使用离心机
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/01_Laboratory Safety Using a Centrifuge.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/01_Laboratory Safety Using a Centrifuge/src.py

points.K6: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
points.K8: 放在稳固水平的台面上
points.S1: 先培训，认准转子和额定转速

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台台式离心机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed benchtop centrifuge on a lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学习怎样安全使用离心机。

shots.scene: 阿杰手里只有一支离心管，直接往离心机里放
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a single centrifuge tube and is about to drop it alone into an open benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 阿杰只有一管样品，想直接开机。

shots.scene: 转子上只有一支管子的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rotor seen from above with only one tube loaded on one side, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一边重一边轻，离心机会剧烈晃动。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向桌上的天平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at a balance scale on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：先配平，再开机。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着高速旋转的转子示意图，周围有弧形箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a simple diagram of a spinning rotor with curved arrows around it.
shots.narration: 离心机靠高速旋转产生离心力。

shots.scene: 一支离心管的分层示意：底部深色，上部浅色
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a centrifuge tube with a dark layer at the bottom and a pale layer on top, a down arrow and an up arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 密度大的沉到管底，密度小的浮在上层。

shots.scene: 迷你、台式、落地式三台离心机图标由小到大排开
shots.prompt_en: Three centrifuge icons in a row from small to large: a mini centrifuge, a benchtop centrifuge and a floor-standing centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机有大有小，型号很多。

shots.scene: 三张图标卡：转速表、离心管、实验室平面
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards: a speed gauge, a centrifuge tube with a volume mark, and a simple lab floor plan. No people.
shots.narration: 按转速、管子大小和样品量来选。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在穿戴整齐的小研旁边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the female graduate student, who wears a lab coat, long pants, closed shoes, safety glasses and gloves.
shots.narration: 用离心机，先把防护穿戴好。

shots.scene: 五个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a lab coat, long pants, a fully enclosed shoe, safety glasses and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、长裤、全包鞋、护目镜、手套。

shots.scene: 小研把离心管一支支放上天平称重
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, weighs centrifuge tubes one by one on a balance scale.
shots.narration: 每支管子都要称重，重量要相当。

shots.scene: 转子俯视图，两支管子放在正对面
shots.prompt_en: A top-view icon of a rotor with two tubes placed directly opposite each other, linked by a dotted line, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 管子放在转子上正对面的位置。

shots.scene: 四支管子对称分布的转子图标
shots.prompt_en: A top-view icon of a rotor with four tubes evenly spaced in a cross pattern, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 多支管子，也要两两对称。

shots.scene: 小研往一支空管里加水，与阿杰的样品管并排
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills an empty tube with water next to the young male student's sample tube.
shots.narration: 只有一管样品，就做一支配平管。

shots.scene: 两支管子放在天平两侧，天平持平
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes on the two pans of a balance scale, perfectly level, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 配平管和样品管，重量要一样。

shots.section_title: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
shots.scene: 吊篮和离心管嵌合的图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a centrifuge tube fitting snugly into a swing bucket, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 吊篮和管子要安装匹配。
overlay: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁

shots.section_title: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
shots.scene: 阿杰用纸巾擦干吊篮内壁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves, wipes the inside of a swing bucket dry with a paper towel.
shots.narration: 里外干燥、清洁，再放进转子。

shots.scene: 阿杰盖上离心机盖，按下锁扣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the centrifuge lid and presses it down until the latch clicks.
shots.narration: 盖好机盖，确认锁紧。

shots.section_title: 放在稳固水平的台面上
shots.scene: 离心机放在平稳的台面上，旁边有水平仪
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge sits on a solid lab bench with a bubble level beside it showing level. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机要放在稳固、水平的台面上。
overlay: 放在稳固水平的台面上

shots.scene: 离心机抖动的示意，周围有震动线
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge with vibration lines around it shakes on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中晃动、摇摆，要立即停机。

shots.scene: 小研站在侧方，伸手按下停止键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side at arm's length and presses the stop button on the centrifuge panel.
shots.narration: 先按停止键，必要时切断电源。

shots.scene: 电源插头已拔下，转子仍在转的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a centrifuge with its plug unplugged while the rotor inside still spins with curved arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 断电只切断动力，转子还会转。

shots.scene: 旋转箭头逐渐变慢变短
shots.prompt_en: Curved spin arrows around a rotor icon get shorter and fainter, showing it slowing down. No people.
shots.narration: 它要靠摩擦，慢慢才停下来。

shots.scene: 开盖的手图标被打叉，旁边是旋转转子
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand opening a lid over a still-spinning rotor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 转子没停稳，绝不开盖。

shots.scene: 小研看着显示屏等待，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waits beside the centrifuge, watching its blank display, with her hands off the lid.
shots.narration: 看清完全停止，再打开机盖。

shots.scene: 转子一侧重一侧轻的天平示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a rotor with a heavy tube on one side and a light tube on the other, tilting like an unbalanced scale. No people.
shots.narration: 晃动，多半是转子没配平。

shots.scene: 损坏的机器和受伤的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked centrifuge and two person pictograms with bandages. No people.
shots.narration: 可能损坏设备，还会伤到身边的人。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅一本空白的离心机安全资料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank centrifuge safety fact sheet with simple pictograms.
shots.narration: 更多要点，查阅离心机安全资料。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question in the lab office.
shots.narration: 有疑问，问实验室安全管理老师。

shots.section_title: 先培训，认准转子和额定转速
shots.scene: 王老师给学生培训，旁边是空白考核表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains a small group of students next to a blank test form on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 第一次使用，先培训，读懂说明书。
overlay: 先培训，认准转子和额定转速

shots.section_title: 先培训，认准转子和额定转速
shots.scene: 转子和离心机用拼图接口连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon and a centrifuge icon linked by a matching puzzle connector, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只用这台离心机配套的转子。

shots.section_title: 先培训，认准转子和额定转速
shots.scene: 转速表指针停在红区之前
shots.prompt_en: A speed gauge icon with the needle stopping just before the red zone, next to a rotor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转速不能超过转子的额定上限。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 离心血液等生物样品，要格外小心。

shots.scene: 密封盖离心管和带锁盖的吊篮
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge tube with a sealed screw cap and a swing bucket with a sealed lid and a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用带盖密封管和密封吊篮。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里装卸吊篮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in lab coat, goggles and gloves, loads a sealed bucket inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 在生物安全柜里装卸，停机静置再开。

shots.scene: 小研站在离心机旁看着空白显示屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the running centrifuge and watches the blank display.
shots.narration: 启动后守在旁边，等平稳了再离开。

shots.scene: 人员后退远离晃动的离心机图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shaking centrifuge with a person pictogram stepping back with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 剧烈晃动时，人员先远离。

shots.scene: 用手按住旋转转子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pressing on a spinning rotor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用手或工具强行刹停转子。

shots.scene: 关闭的离心机挂着暂停使用牌
shots.prompt_en: A closed centrifuge with a blank out-of-service tag hanging on the lid and an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 发现破管溢漏，先关盖，静置一会儿。

shots.scene: 镊子夹起碎片放入锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers pick up broken plastic pieces and place them into a sharps box. No people.
shots.narration: 碎片用镊子夹，不要徒手捡。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套擦拭离心腔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, wipes the inside of the centrifuge chamber with paper towels.
shots.narration: 按规程清洁消毒，废物分类处置。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—学校
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a university building. No people.
shots.narration: 设备损坏、破管、受伤，都要报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at a lab eyewash station, holding his eyelids open.
shots.narration: 样品溅到身上或眼里，立即冲洗。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 需要就医及时就医，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现防护、天平、锁盖图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of safety glasses, a balance scale and a locked lid.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，称重配平，锁好机盖。

shots.scene: 水平仪、停止键、停转转子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a bubble level, a stop button and a stopped rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 台面平稳，晃动停机，停稳再开。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志、报告单和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biohazard warning sign, a blank report form and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 生物样品要密封，出了状况就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在离心机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy benchtop centrifuge with its lid closed.
shots.narration: 平稳离心，安全实验，下次见！
